explication: CloakBrowser is a multi-language drop-in Playwright/Puppeteer client for launching a patched stealth Chromium. Developers call a Python, JavaScript, Puppeteer, or .NET launch API; the launcher resolves configuration, obtains a licensed or free cached binary, starts the browser engine, optionally applies proxy/geo-IP alignment and humanized interactions, then drives target websites. Persistent profiles and Widevine are separate runtime capabilities. The map emphasizes documented flows; several implementation links remain omitted because their source was not sampled.
